create_dictionary_read_vocab: create a dictionary from a vocabulary file using Dictionary.read_vocab with a path to a word-count file
index_data_sentences: index sentences from a text file into word IDs using Dictionary.index_data with a dictionary and output path
limit_dictionary_vocab: limit the dictionary vocabulary size to a maximum number of words using Dictionary.max_vocab
filter_dictionary_min_count: filter dictionary words by minimum frequency count using Dictionary.min_count
lookup_word_index: lookup the index of a word in the dictionary using Dictionary.index with optional no-unk behavior
